Current browser URL: http://127.0.0.1:3000/dashboard/new?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&editPanel=1&showCategory=Panel%20options — i.e. the unsaved "New dashboard" panel editor, not a saved dashboard.

summary: Set the tag and default time range and saved explicitly. In Dashboard settings > General I added the tag "bench" to fwgr89-luna-n1 Bench Dashboard (uid bfzr82uf2zqpse), then saved via Save dashboard with the "Update default time range" checkbox ticked (the time picker already read "Last 6 hours"); Grafana returned the "Dashboard saved" alert. Verification after a full reload of the bare dashboard URL (no query params): the tag chip in Settings > General still reads "bench", and Grafana rendered the default range as from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser with the picker reading "Last 6 hours". Corroborating this: when I re-opened the Save dashboard drawer on that fresh 6h load, the "Update default time range" checkbox was no longer offered and Save was disabled, i.e. the current range now equals the dashboard's stored default (before this save the checkbox was present, so the default then differed). The saved model I read off the dashboard's JSON Model tab showed dashboard_model_version 4 with timezone browser. Both panels (fwgr89-luna-n1 Notes, fwgr89-luna-n1 Availability) are intact. Note: while briefly on the JSON Model tab, a find/type attempt wrote "now-6h" into that editor buffer; I never clicked "Save changes", I reloaded the page, and the editor's Save button was disabled afterwards — so no JSON edit was persisted. (default_time_range: from=now-6h&to=now applied on a bare URL load, no query params)

summary: Set auto-refresh to 1m and saved the dashboard explicitly. In the dashboard's top bar I opened the refresh-interval picker (it read "Off"/auto refresh turned off) and chose "1m" — the control then displayed "1m". I then clicked Save dashboard; the drawer reported "No changes to save" with Save disabled until I ticked its "Update default refresh value (Will make the current refresh the new default)" option, after which Save was clicked and Grafana returned the "Dashboard saved" alert. Verified after a full reload of the bare dashboard URL (no query params): the top-bar refresh control reads "1m" with aria-label "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected", document title "Dashboards - Grafana" with breadcrumb "fwgr89-luna-n1 Bench Dashboard", time range still "Last 6 hours", and both panels intact (fwgr89-luna-n1 Notes with runid text, fwgr89-luna-n1 Availability showing 84.1). Screenshot captured.
